messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up: planning a multi-PR docs restructure to move /guides/runtime/* -> /runtime/guides/* to consolidate runtime docs. Splitting into 4 small PRs to keep previews fast. Need reviewer plan + a safe merge order.
Jon Reed: Can you list the PR numbers and what each contains?
Aisha Patel: PRs: #5001 (top-level redirects + index move), #5003 (runtime API pages), #5005 (code examples & SDK snippets), #5007 (link cleanup + permalink aliases). #5003 touches anchors heavily.
Maya Ortiz: I worry about external links pointing at old anchors (some are from community posts). We should create temporary anchor aliases in the moved files and add redirect rules for a handful of high-traffic permalinks.
Ben Holt: Proposed merge order: #5001 -> #5005 -> #5003 -> #5007. My reasoning: establish path redirects first, then update examples to reference new anchors, then move API pages, finally cleanup. But that means #5003 should be last among moves.
Priya Kapoor: We usually merge moves before examples to avoid build errors in CI. Is the docs-preview link-checker configured to follow redirects? If not, it will show false positives.
Aisha Patel: Good catch. I'll enable --follow-redirects in the link-check job for this run. Also, set preview CDN TTL to 30s for the canary window so we get fresh responses.
docs-ci-bot: docs-preview triggered for PR #5001 - build queued.
cdn-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-5001 - remember to wait for CDN invalidation.
Jon Reed: Ran the local link-checker against pr-5003 and got: Broken anchor runtime/api/connections.md#connection-lifecycle referenced by examples/sdk/python.md line 42.
Maya Ortiz: If that anchor name changes due to heading normalization, we can add an alias in the moved file like: <!-- ALIAS: connection-lifecycle --> then the static site generator will keep the old id. Alternatively, change the example to the new id. Which is faster?
Ben Holt: Adding HTML alias is fastest and least disruptive. We'll also add a short-lived redirect rule for the specific external permalink the legal team flagged.
Priya Kapoor: For transparency, put the dependent PRs and the merge window in each PR description. Recommend a 2-hour canary tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT. Merge #5001, wait 15m, merge #5005, smoke check, then #5003 if no anchor errors.
Aisha Patel: Will do. Also adding a tiny link-check patch to #5005 to update examples to new paths so they won't break when #5003 lands.
docs-ci-bot: docs-preview build succeeded for PR #5001 - status: success.
cdn-bot: CDN invalidation in progress for preview 5001, ETA ~10m.
Jon Reed: After CDN update, link-checker run (with --follow-redirects) shows two remaining anchor warnings: examples/sdk/python.md -> runtime/api/connections.md#connection-lifecycle and external blog /platform/runtime#auth-flow.
Maya Ortiz: I'll open a micro-PR to add an alias anchor in runtime/api/connections.md and add a single-entry redirect for /platform/runtime#auth-flow in #5001 with an expiration comment.
Ben Holt: Plan for rollbacks: if anchor regression leads to >5% 404s on indexed pages in prod (tracking via analytics), revert the migration PRs in reverse order and re-open a hotfix that reintroduces old anchors. Add the rollback checklist to the umbrella issue.
Priya Kapoor: Also ask search infra to reindex after the final merge window - add a post-merge task in each PR checklist.
Aisha Patel: Thanks. Assigning reviewers: Jon -> #5005, Maya -> #5003, Ben -> #5001, Priya -> #5007. Please leave short notes about smoke-check steps.
Maya Ortiz: I'll review #5003 tonight and run a full anchor audit.
Jon Reed: Running link-check: command I used:
```
./scripts/link-checker --dir=public --follow-redirects --report=anchor-warnings.json
```
Will paste results after run.
Maya Ortiz: Small FYI: include the specific external permalinks we plan to redirect in a comment block in _redirects.yml so we can remove them cleanly after 60 days.
Aisha Patel: Good point. Using a TTL comment + expiration date in the redirect entry.
docs-ci-bot: docs-preview for PR #5005 started - status: pending.
Jon Reed: Link-checker results: no 4xx for pages, 2 anchor warnings (same as above). Patch branch ready to add alias in #5003 and a short redirect in #5001.
Maya Ortiz: After alias PR lands, we'll re-run link-checker on preview and merge #5003. Then #5007 to remove temporary redirects and tidy anchors.
Ben Holt: Final note: please leave tiny review comments reminding merges must be done during canary window and to notify infra when merging so they can watch indexing and CDN metrics.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all — updating the umbrella issue, PR descriptions, and adding the merge checklist now. Ping here when you start the review so we can coordinate the canary.
